_comment: Tracked allowlist for the release gate (docs/release-gate.md). knownFailures: pre-existing failing test files, each with the reason and the exact names of the tests expected to fail ('failing'); any OTHER failing test fails the gate, and a listed test that starts passing must be removed. sandboxIntegrationRoutes: exact route + status the sandbox tolerates because it deliberately has no Replit connectors or KONG access. Adding or changing entries requires the PR label gate-justified.
